narratives.Overview:
## Summary

On Grok Build, a registered Directive `PreToolUse` hook did not run, and the host did not deny the tools. An implement worker wrote product code and opened a pull request with no scope xBRIEF for that work.

The story-start gate (`scope:promote`, `scope:activate`, `xbrief:preflight`) exists as prose and as a CLI. It is not a fail-closed gate on this host when `deft-hook` is absent.

## What happened

Consumer: `deftai/deftvisage`. Host: Grok Build on macOS. Deposit pin: `@deftai/dire

## Prefer-A Bound
Implement Prefer-A Bound Recut3 https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/5656#issuecomment-6201860683 (closes P1–P4). Tracking/Refs only on product PR.
